purpose: Provide the official runtime frames for Raelyn, the project's sole playable character, without changing stats, equipment, gameplay, combat resolution, or save structure.

source.note: Third-party original game material; retained here under the user's explicit project authorization for the official Raelyn character runtime.

sourceSpec.alignment: Original full-frame canvas and per-frame offsets are preserved.

runtime.directionMapping: render.js facingRight selects right; otherwise left.
runtime.visibleHeightTarget: approximately 64px for standing and walking frames
runtime.timingNote: Attack and death are accelerated from the 30 FPS source timing so their complete controlled sequences fit the current 1.05s attack interval and 1.35s defeat hold.
runtime.speedMultiplier: At 2x speed, the independent character animation clock advances at twice the 1x rate for idle, walk, melee_attack, and death.
runtime.shadowPolicy: The Raelyn PNG branch adds no procedural character shadow; the generic procedural fallback retains its own ground shadow.
runtime.fallback: If the requested PNG is unavailable, incomplete, failed, or has an unexpected canvas size, render.js draws a generic procedural warrior without a character-specific identity.
